source_land.dataset: Natural Earth 1:10m physical vector land polygon v5.1.1 (independent coastline)
source_land.licensing: Natural Earth: public domain; do not redistribute GIS source in Structural artifacts
source_land.version_note: This is NOT original GADM 3.6. Same-landmass candidate verification should be tested against original-vintage GADM separately before final original-source validation.

fixed_geometric_rule.method: Clip Natural Earth land polygons to 0.5-degree-expanded bbox around BOTH points, union them, then test source survey center and original heldout centroid are contained in the same connected clipped-land polygon.

output: 15 source study IDs/landscape, nearest source-heldout ID, distance and geometry class
aggregate count by country and geometry class
downloaded public coastline ZIP SHA256 and source version
evidence_limit: Strong evidence for same candidate physical land mass is necessary but insufficient for exact island population identity, surveyed native status or observed source movement.
